title: Lab, Dispensing and Eyewear Care Standards at Northgate Optical
content:
The optical counter submits a verified Northgate Optical job to the lens lab, and the eyewear is dispensed only by an optician who fits it on the patient; eyewear is never shipped. Frame adjustments and nose pad replacements are free for the life of the eyewear on every lens design. A frame that breaks from a manufacturing defect within the design's frame warranty months of dispensing is replaced through a frame defect remake. Lab status questions are answered from the job's status; member services cannot expedite a lab.

## Job statuses and what they mean

| Status on the job | Meaning | How the job reaches it |
|---|---|---|
| ordered | the job has been placed and its charges posted | order placed at the optical counter |
| in lab | the verified job is with the lens lab | the optical counter submits it |
| ready for pickup | finished or remade eyewear has arrived at the club and passed inspection | arrival from the lab |
| dispensed | the optician has fitted the eyewear and handed it to the patient | fitting at the counter; the first dispensing sets the dispensed date |
| remake in lab | a remake of dispensed eyewear has been opened and sent to the lab | a remake is opened |
| returned | dispensed eyewear has been returned for a refund within the satisfaction window | a satisfaction return |
| cancelled | the job was cancelled before the eyewear reached ready for pickup | a cancellation from ordered or in lab |

The dispensed date is the date of the first dispensing and is not moved by later remakes.

## Questions the standard answers

**Can a pair be mailed to the member?** No. Eyewear is never shipped; it is dispensed by an optician who fits it.

**A member asks when the lab will finish.** The answer is given from the job's status. Member services cannot expedite a lab.

**Is there a charge for a new set of nose pads?** No. Nose pad replacements and frame adjustments are free for the life of the eyewear.
